question: What a fleet's select_land and select_air buttons do when pressed, and what the unit panel's unitstrength shows for a fleet or an air unit

addresses.name: NavyOrAir_StrengthText
addresses.comment: **Slot 37 of CNavy and of CAir, one body for both**: the header's `unitstrength` for a fleet or an air unit - CArmy's own slot 37 is CArmy::StrengthText, its men. Clears the out string, then `_itoa(this->regiments_count (+0x40), buf, 10)` and assigns the digits: **the count of the unit's own ships or wings, plain decimal**, with no colour, no thousands separator, and nothing asked of any ship's or wing's strength. Returns the out string, `ret 4`. CUnitView::Update calls the unit's slot 37 for the header and for each row of the panel of several. Two sibling classes share it, so it is named for neither (trap 4). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-unitpanel.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: vtable.py --holding 0x5D0770: exactly two tables, CNavy slot 37 (0x15C869C) and CAir slot 37 (0x15C8774); CArmy's slot 37 (table 0x15BDE0C, read at +0x94) is 0x5CE550, CArmy::StrengthText, already recorded. Listing 0x5D0770-0x5D07E9: `mov ecx,[ecx+0x40]`, out = [ebp+8] set to an empty SSO string (+0x14 = 0xF, +0x10 = 0, byte 0), `push 0xA; lea eax,[ebp-0x30]; push eax; push ecx; call 0xB9A0C4` (_itoa, rva 0x79A0C4, recorded), strlen inline, `call 0x40A160` (std::string::assign) on the out string, `ret 4`. CUnit +0x40 is regiments_count in the record. Would be wrong if CUnitView::Update did not reach slot 37 for unitstrength (the record's reading of 0x36C7F0 says it does) - and on screen the Home Fleet of 1936 reads 19 in the original as it does here, 10 capital ships and 9 screens, which the maintainer can confirm with a glance.

addresses.name: CWindowForLoadedUnitsEntry::OnSelectLand
addresses.comment: `select_land`'s click. **Nothing at all unless the panel's unit (+0x28) is a fleet** (its slot 16, IsNaval) - so on an air unit's panel, where the update enables the button over paratroopers aboard, a press does nothing. For a fleet: the in-game screen (g_CCurrentGameState +0xBE8) is asked slot 43, CInGameIdler::DeselectLater, with null - every thing now selected, the fleet among it, queued to be let go at the end of the frame's panel pass - then each unit of the fleet's carrying list (AsNavy, slot 11, then +0x2E4) in list order is handed to slot 38, CInGameIdler::Select, which appends it. So the passengers replace the selection; the map is not moved and nothing is posted. Shortcut '.' in the .gui. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-transport.md, section C.2. **Corrected 2026-11-14**: this said 'for a fleet or an air unit' and 'the selection emptied'.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x758B00-0x758C7B: `mov ecx,[edi+0x28]; mov edx,[eax+0x40]; call edx; test al,al; je` the exit - vftable slot 16, which is `mov al,1; ret` in CNavy's table (0xA92590) and `xor al,al; ret` in CAir's and CArmy's (0x592360), read at table + 0x40. Then g_CCurrentGameState (0x1A89790, made on demand) +0xBE8, `[eax+0xAC]` with `push ebx` (0) - slot 43; then `[eax+0x2C]` on the unit - slot 11, `mov eax,ecx; ret` for CNavy - and the list at +0x2E4 walked node by node ([node] the unit, [node+8] the next), each pushed to `[edx+0x98]` - slot 38. No call to a centring or sound routine. Would be wrong if slot 16 were not IsNaval: the record names it so for CUnit, CNavy and CAir.

addresses.name: CWindowForLoadedUnitsEntry::OnSelectAir
addresses.comment: `select_air`'s click: nothing unless the panel's unit (+0x28) is a fleet (slot 16, IsNaval). Then CInGameIdler::DeselectLater (slot 43) with null - everything selected, the fleet among it, let go at the end of the frame's panel pass - and, ship by ship in the fleet's list (+0x38), for each ship whose definition (+0x58) has carrier_size (+0x190) above 0, every air unit of its +0xDC list in order handed to CInGameIdler::Select (slot 38). The map is not moved and nothing is posted. Shortcut ',' in the .gui. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-transport.md, section C.2. **Corrected 2026-11-14**: 'the selection is emptied' was DeselectLater, which lets go at the end of the panel pass.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x758940-0x758AF4: the slot-16 test as in OnSelectLand (`[eax+0x40]`, `je 0x758AE4`); `[eax+0xAC]` with 0 on g_CCurrentGameState +0xBE8; `[edi+0x28]` + 0x38 the ship list; per node `[eax+0x58]` then `cmp [ecx+0x190],ebx; jle` the next ship; `[eax+0xDC]` the aircraft list, each node's unit pushed to `[eax+0x98]`. Would be wrong if +0x190 of a sub-unit definition were not carrier_size: the record and CNavy::SendCarrierAircraft read it so.

slots_noted: NavyOrAir_StrengthText is slot 37 of both CNavy and CAir and is named for neither (trap 4); the slot is recorded as StrengthText on both, matching CArmy's slot 37, CArmy::StrengthText.
